svg.title: RMR-CB-DECK-UPPER DECK PLATE, UPPER
svg.text: VIEW AS IN THE DXF, SCALE 1:2
DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETERS; THIS DRAWING GOVERNS. AN INCH VERSION IS DRAWING RMR-CB-DECK-UPPER-IN.
MAKE FROM deck_upper_plate.dxf (MILLIMETERS, LAYER CUT, IN THE FRAME OF THIS VIEW) BY ANY PROCESS THAT HOLDS THE TOLERANCES.
THE FILE'S HOLES AND SLOTS ARE AT THEIR LEAST SIZE AND ITS OUTLINE AT ITS LARGEST: CUT TO THE MIDDLE OF EACH TOLERANCE, NOT
ON THE FILE'S LINES. REPORT ANY DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE FILE AND THIS DRAWING BEFORE CUTTING.
DATUMS: THE CENTERS OF HOLES A1 (X 10.00, Y 10.00) AND A3 (Y 10.00). MEASURE EVERY CENTER AND EDGE FROM THEM, NOT FROM THE
CUT EDGES. EACH EDGE LIES ON ITS NOMINAL LINE OR UP TO 0.5 INSIDE IT, NEVER OUTSIDE.
ALL HOLES AND SLOTS THRU. DEBURR EVERY EDGE, HOLE AND SLOT ON BOTH FACES.
MARK THE PART NUMBER "RMR-CB-DECK-UPPER REV A" IN PERMANENT INK ON THE FACE SHOWN, NEAR THE ORIGIN.
THE CUSTOMER MAY SUPPLY THE MATERIAL AS ONE 18 X 24 IN SHEET OF 5052: USE IT AS SUPPLIED, NO CERTIFICATE NEEDED.
X, Y: CENTER FROM THE ORIGIN 0, 0, THE NOMINAL LOWER LEFT CORNER.
SLOT W X L: WIDTH X OVERALL LENGTH, FULL-RADIUS ENDS, LONG AXIS ALONG X
AL 5052-H32 SHEET, 0.063 IN (1.59 MM), ASTM B209
NONE, MILL FINISH: NO ANODIZE, PAINT OR COATING
